physical_instances.rule: Assign a new tool instance ID after every reprint or geometry-changing rework and a new installation session ID/start UTC after every remount. These IDs must match fixture-frame commissioning before any KST connection.

tool_clocking_and_low_load_requalificati.measurement_method: post-print optical/CMM datum check, installed peg/socket yaw check and guarded low-load fingerprint/capture replay
tool_clocking_and_low_load_requalificati.rule: GEOMETRY_QUALIFIED permits only the guarded sampling lane; QUALIFIED plus the explicit low-load flag is required for a full-loop run.

tcp_pivot_touch_off_commissioning.transform_semantics: media-flange origin to registered peg-tip TCP translation, expressed in the media-flange frame at the qualified upright installation
tcp_pivot_touch_off_commissioning.measurement_method: multi-orientation pivot fit plus independent fixture-top touch-off and dial/vision runout check after final flange installation

payload_identification.measurement_method: multi-orientation static wrench identification with the complete installed M12 flange-peg

controller_load_handling_qualification.controller_deployment_session_rule: Generate a new UUID after every Sunrise project, application, or LoadData redeploy; never reuse a prior deployment-session UUID.
controller_load_handling_qualification.sunrise_readback_schema: Every QUALIFIED full-loop path must provide evidence JSON with schema_version=1, status=QUALIFIED, readback_confirmed_active_project=true, running_application_state=RUNNING, readback_method, readback_utc formatted YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ, controller_station_identity, robot_ip, controller_deployment_session_id, sunrise_application_name, sunrise_project_source_sha256, and matching physical_tool_instance_id/installation_session_id. The controller identity/IP/deployment, application and source SHA must equal preregistration; the SHA must be recomputed from the exported project bundle; and the readback must postdate this installation and controller deployment and be at most 900 s old before KST connection. If the nonzero-LoadData path is selected, additionally require matching load_data_name, source_payload_evidence_sha256, LoadData deployment UTC, and registered mass/CoM/inertia expressed in the Bota sensor measurement frame.
controller_load_handling_qualification.measurement_method: either hash-verify nonzero Sunrise LoadData for the complete installed tool, or independently measure representative full-cone DirectServo phase/tip tracking with the final installed load
controller_load_handling_qualification.rule: Payload identification alone is not controller compensation. Before KST, every full-loop path requires a fresh hash-bound attestation of the current controller deployment. Load handling then requires one or both paths: verified nonzero Sunrise LoadData whose active application/load names and payload readback match preregistration; and/or independent full-cone tracking under the final installed load, bound to the same controller deployment session.

sensor_metrology.transform_convention: T_A_from_B maps homogeneous coordinates expressed in frame B into frame A; translation is the B-origin position expressed in A
sensor_metrology.measurement_method: rigid-chain frame calibration plus independent touch-off cross-check after final installation

conical_phase_pose_tracking_qualificatio.evidence_schema: Evidence JSON must contain schema_version=1, status=QUALIFIED, matching physical_tool_instance_id/installation_session_id/controller_deployment_session_id, active_matlab_source_sha256, conical_tilt_deg, conical_command_rate_hz, conical_scan_s, conical_phase_bins and conical_feedback_policy.
conical_phase_pose_tracking_qualificatio.measurement_method: independent timestamp-aligned measured robot pose or external tip tracking during the full DirectServo cone; command-propagated pose rows are not evidence
conical_phase_pose_tracking_qualificatio.rule: Pending or malformed qualification does not authorize any clean training candidate. It may still permit guarded diagnostic acquisition when every separate motion gate passes.

combined_lateral_uncertainty_budget.margin_rule: The 0.30 mm cap is stricter than radius*tan(5 deg)=0.496 mm at the minimum printed-CAD M12 clean-candidate radius.

authorization.rule: This template is fail-closed. Complete hash-pinned evidence, physical-instance IDs and explicit review before enabling either authorization.

claim_boundary: This file is a commissioning template, not measured evidence. Nominal 92 mm stack length, CAD mass and assumed sensor axes cannot authorize robot motion or training labels.
